identify: The female fly puts eggs inside the skin of ripe fruit.
The maggots feed on the fruit pulp and the fruit rots.

cultural: Collect the infested and fallen fruits and dispose of them. Do this 30-40 days before harvest.
Plough the orchard in November-December to expose the pupae to the heat of the sun.
biological: Use methyl eugenol pheromone traps at 4/acre.
